On the schedule below (every day around 2 AM unless you change it), a copy of everything — tasks, notes and the recycle bin — goes to your OneDrive (Apps › RemFT). Each file is uploaded once, on its own, to Apps › RemFT › Files; the backup lists them instead of copying them again. It runs in the background, or when you open the app if it was missed, over Wi-Fi or mobile data. Backups are not encrypted: anyone who can open the Microsoft account can read them. Restore one with “Restore from backup”.
